solve_lqr_optimal_policy: solve the LQR problem for a dm_control environment and return the optimal policy matrix and convergence rate
solve_dare_iteratively: solve the discrete-time algebraic Riccati equation by iteration given transition and cost matrices
compute_lqr_gain_matrix: compute the optimal linear feedback gain matrix K for a dm_control LQR environment
check_lqr_stability: check if a controlled LQR system is stable by computing the maximum eigenvalue of the closed-loop matrix
run_lqr_solver: run the LQR solver on a dm_control MuJoCo environment to get the value function Hessian and policy
